Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The study employs two main proteomics strategies: 1) Complexome profiling via Size Exclusion Chromatography (SEC) to identify high molecular weight (HMW) assemblies, and 2) Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry (AP-MS) using GFP and ALFA tags to validate the PRPS complex. Acquisition is DDA based on the use of Sequest HT and Orbitrap Eclipse for shotgun proteomics. Labeling is label-free (LFQ), with PRIDE metadata explicitly listing 'Peptide counting' as the quantification method.
